### struct `LoadGuard`

CPU hogs held for the length of a probe, so a run can be measured against a machine that is actually busy — the one condition the production pathology always appeared under and that an otherwise-idle laptop never reproduces. Dropping the guard kills every hog.

```rust
struct LoadGuard(Vec<std::process::Child>);
```

### struct `ExecGuard`

Load that forces macOS to validate a *fresh* Mach-O on every exec — what a package install does when it unpacks thousands of new binaries, and the one kind of pressure a CPU busy-loop cannot imitate. Each iteration copies a signed system binary to a new inode and runs it, so `amfid`/`syspolicyd` cannot serve the check from cache.

```rust
struct ExecGuard(Vec<std::process::Child>, PathBuf);
```
